verdict.rationale: SumUp documents webhooks for checkout status changes only, explicitly stating 'our system only allows you to get notified about a status change for a checkout' — there's no evidence of separate authorized/captured/disputed event types, only checkout status transitions that may implicitly cover paid/refunded states. Missing for 10: explicit event types for authorization vs capture vs dispute, webhook payload/signature verification docs, and any mention of dispute/chargeback webhook events.
